4. Conflicts (Sofia): The counterparty's founder is a current firm client in an unrelated matter adverse to our licensing client. We need the founder's informed written consent and an ethical screen before execution.

Given that all four issues require substantive changes to the agreement or pre-execution deliverables, I cannot approve execution as currently drafted. I'd like each of you to confirm you can complete your respective fixes within the next week so we can assess whether the timeline is still feasible.
